newsitem.title: ITALY: IMI, CSFB coordinators to ENI sale.
newsitem.headline: IMI, CSFB coordinators to ENI sale.

text.p: Italian investment bank IMI and Cs First Boston have been appointed global coordinators for the sale of the third tranche of Italian state-controlled energy company ENI, the Treasury said in a statement.
NM Rothschild is appointed advisor to the sale, it said.
The Treasury, which currently holds 69 percent of ENI, plans to complete the placement of the third tranche by the summer.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi has said the state's holding will not fall below 51 percent.
The second tranche was offered in November 1996 and the first at the end of 1995.
